About Organization

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) is a constitutional body in India that is responsible for conducting various exams for recruitment to the Indian civil services. The UPSC was established on October 1, 1926, and it is headquartered in New Delhi.
The UPSC is responsible for conducting exams such as the Civil Services Exam, the Indian Forest Service Exam, and the National Defence Academy Exam, among others.

About the Programme

The UPSC NDA II Exam is a national-level exam that is conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) for admission to the National Defence Academy (NDA) and the Naval Academy. The exam is held twice a year, and it is a gateway for candidates who want to join the Indian Armed Forces.
The NDA II Exam is a written exam that tests the candidate's knowledge in subjects such as mathematics, science, and social science. The exam is followed by an interview and a medical test, and the final selection is based on the candidate's performance in all these stages.

CareerFlora Expert Insight

The UPSC NDA II Exam is a great opportunity for candidates who want to join the Indian Armed Forces. The exam is highly competitive, and candidates need to prepare well to crack it. The selection process is based on the candidate's performance in the written exam, interview, and medical test.
Candidates should start preparing for the exam at least 6 months in advance. They should focus on building their knowledge in subjects such as mathematics, science, and social science. They should also practice mock tests and previous year question papers to get an idea of the exam pattern and the type of questions asked.
